items.text: [p align="start"]Dear Knightlings,
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]With the holidays fast approaching, here is a small gift for you: Patch Three! This update includes a number of fixes and improvements:
Finding the librarian when returning to the city before the last stretch of the game
Fast travel enabling logic in the last region
Bob t-posing in the waterwheel sidequest in Outskirts
Some grabbable object fixes for when straying too far
Special dialogue triggering when a different order of defeating the Alchemist Bandit
Getting stuck in the first Stargazing puzzle
Fixing a bug going into Koinyx from Lost Expedition
Fishling outfit no longer purchasable from tailor Rhapso, instead only found in a racing chest
Fixed various floating assets
Fixed various misplaced decals
Fixed Various small terrain gaps
Fixed various cinematic glitches
Russian localization added
Fixed various localization issues
Performance optimizations
Memory optimizations
UI scaling improvements for different languages and screen sizes
Increased size of button prompts

[p align="start"]Thank you all for your continuing support, and here's hoping that you have a wonderful holiday season! In the meantime, if you encounter any issues, please report them to the support team here.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
Dear Knightlings,
We have released a small patch to resolve a security issue affecting games using the Unity engine.
Dear Knightlings,
Patch Two is out today! We’ve been gathering your feedback, and you can check out all the fixes in this update below.

notes.title: This update includes a number of fixes and improvements

items.text: Added key rebinding.
Updated the world map to show the area of the region you are hovering the cursor over.
Races are now marked as ‘completed’ on the map.
Fixed an issue where map markers were not updating correctly when reloading the game.
Updated the maps' legend.
Removed a chest that was marked on the map but did not exist.
Increased cooldowns on Magnus’ commentaries.
Fixed issues with the message of the day widget.
Fixed low-res savefile images.
Improved the speed at which the game closes when you quit.
Fixed a bug where the pause menu appeared when taking a screenshot.
Added a manual save file limit to resolve an issue where the game no longer saved your progress.
Fixed the stargazing puzzle in the Windtorn Fields to prevent the player from pushing batteries to an unrecoverable location.
We continue to work on further stability improvements, fixing various bugs, and Russian text localization. In the meantime, if you encounter any issues, please report them to our support team here.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147446/7e9f6da4c07b5fb1a46e14e13bd4ef639e01715a.jpg"]
Dear Knightlings,

Today, we are releasing our first patch, Patch 1! Thank you once again for all your support. We also appreciate those who have been reporting issues and providing feedback. It really helps us improve the game!

notes.title: This update includes a number of fixes and improvements

items.text: Added the ability for players to delete save files from the menu.
Improved UI scaling
Fixed various quest and encounter issues.
Fixed an issue where Praise Vessel stamps on the map in Windtorn Fields would not show as complete after being collected.
Fixed an issue where The Blades of the windmill in Windtorn Fields would disappear after a cutscene.
Fixed an issue where Earthborn sword attacks would miss too often.
Fixed an issue where Archers in the Cornered Bosk crypt encounter would not react to the large explosive battery, making the fight harder than intended.
Fixed an issue where Miscreants would spawn inside objects’ geometry.
PlayStation Only
If you had trouble saving or creating a new save file, please delete an existing save file with the new delete save functionality.
We are continuing to improve the game and are currently working on further improvements to stability, fixing various bugs, adding the ability to rebind keys, and working on Russian text localization.
While working on these patches, we will closely follow more feedback coming in and work on fixes accordingly. If you encounter any other issues, please report them to our support team here:

If you encounter further progression issues, please come to the Discord for assistance!

releases.displayName: The Knightling - Pre-Launch Trailer and Development Update

items.text: Slide into adventure – in style!
🛡️ In just a fortnight, adventure begins with you as The Knightling! Coming August 28, to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

A lot has happened since we launched the Outskirts demo on Steam earlier this year! The feedback we gathered was invaluable and we spent our time wisely on a wide range of improvements, fixes and optimizations. In addition to expanding beyond the outskirts region featured in the demo, the upcoming full release will include a variety of new features and improvements.
UI overhauls and improvements, adding visual flair and functionality(such as inscriptions, cosmetics, etc.)
Lighting and visual improvements across the board.
Those with sharp ears might notice the final music mixing with nearly all instruments live-recorded by musicians! Really takes the experience up a notch.
Big optimizations on all systems and logic.
Localization added for multiple languages.
Combat balancing and tweaks.
Cosmetics have been added, and they can be purchased with Guilders from the tailor or obtained through activities.
Included in the base game, you can dress your Knightling in a range of outfit colours and pick ribbon styles that add some flair. Mix and match to create a look that’s entirely your own!

In Clesseia, the main city in the game, Rhapso is the tailor and keeps shop on top of the large bridge. As the Knightling, you can visit the tailor to check out some new outfit colourings, ribbon designs, and styles for Magnustego, the shield!

[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfmIkdhqNLoktXphE0DPhrEVvEzL2eQdUb8TZqmH-MilznHmHxiSdJwBXhcrBN5fUmBmIys4tJouDyZB2_VY0jECpSe823srXOT4tyjDVcPCZvXBWW4wXVbjyuOTm6nw9IzwGDyNA?key=q6L_RgxOAfYxtdkSF8UAKg"]

We took inspiration from the game world, characters, and creatures to make it all fit together. We included the whole team in the brainstorm about what kinds of colour options would be cool. Some were inspired by the roles and jobs you see around the city, some by the environment, and even one inspired by the darker days in life.

Each region also has a distinct colour option for both the Knightling and the shield, which you can earn through various activities in the game. The tailor loves painting the shield for you as well, so it's definitely worth paying a visit if you want to see how fabulous Magnustego can get!

[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcgZKZYf-w_r46uN7JihKNN503S_6qepxoSRXkRGReFC4e0T1d3Lxt0wk90Vg2JFWWRKlUiWjdiFeAXdBj7Jpd090b2g1lH6XmBqYt9AtwSaA6tLNo1qtb7N8_tmCZAZn-N-jaP-w?key=q6L_RgxOAfYxtdkSF8UAKg"]
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]The Knightling - Deluxe Edition features the base game, plus exclusive in-game cosmetics. Defend the people of Clesseia with regal Golden colours for you and your shield, and light the path of justice with a special lantern ribbon. Our Pine players may recognize we also have a set that’s an ode to Albamare!

[p align="justify"] [img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfYZGrK-xKB4il7UEAHqJK2P5LMXLKq9nvx4SNBsubW6pKxyjFOPbyKLLef_yQeT9k379ZlfvdTcWpD8tA15MGuSMRlHwBmQ5inBl0NOHE77ZpBtPwNV0cwmrsP9cw1q4IGZdQm?key=q6L_RgxOAfYxtdkSF8UAKg"]
[p align="justify"]The Deluxe Edition of The Knightling will be available on August 28 for $34.99 | £25.99 | €34.99 (Standard Edition $29.99 | £ 21.99 | €29.99).
Brave knightlings! 🛡️
Today’s update is all about improving performance. A huge thank you to everyone who shared their specs and feedback, it’s been incredibly helpful in guiding these improvements. 🥳
We are continuing to make improvements, in order to give everyone the best experience possible. So, please continue to share your feedback and any issues that you might have with us. 💪

📹 Don’t forget that we love watching your gameplay clips! If you’ve been capturing some nice videos, send them over for a chance to be featured on our social media channels: https://forms.gle/Lj7S9j14vjLfefNi6
🐞 If you run into any issues or bugs, please report them to our support team: https://support.saber.games It really helps us be able to deliver the best game patches to you.
🛡️ Now, go forth and put your skills to the test once more! Keep sharing your feedback here on Steam and in Discord, so we will forge a greater adventure together. See you in the outskirts!

releases.displayName: The Knightling Demo - February 25, 2025 Patch Notes

items.text: Brave knightlings, the outskirts region has received a small but mighty update! 🛡️ Thanks to your keen eyes and feedback, we’ve made some improvements to The Knightling demo.
Added a controls reminder screen to settings (key rebinding coming in full game).
The default camera sensitivity has been lowered.
Human soldiers and knights no longer chase you to the edge of the world when attacked.
Added tutorials for nimble-type enemies, healing, and more.
Unlocked the Index of Foes subtab, where you can read about some of the enemies you have encountered.
Fixing an issue where time of day lighting from sky would sometimes be reflected incorrectly on environmental assets.
Fixing an issue where music would sometimes not play during exploration or combat.
Additionally, we're working hard on performance optimizations to ensure the game runs smoother on all setups!

📹 Don’t forget that we love watching your gameplay clips! If you’ve been capturing some nice videos, send them over for a chance to be featured on our social media channels: https://forms.gle/Lj7S9j14vjLfefNi6
